title: Cod and Potato Stew - Spanish Sabores
ldKeywords: cod stew recipe, fish stew, potato stew recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 pound dried salt cod (desalinated and chopped)
4  medium red potatoes (peeled and cut in wedges)
1/2 cup homemade shrimp stock (or store bought)
ldInstructionsRaw: Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan and when hot but not smoking, add the diced onion and leek and sauté over a medium heat for about 5 minutes.
Add the rosemary and the chopped desalinated salt cod and sauté for another 5 minutes.
Add the potato wedges and cover with 1/2 cup shrimp stock and two cups of water (or enough water to cover the potatoes and cod).
Bring to a slow boil and then lower to a simmer. Cook until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and serve piping hot. Watch out for small bones when eating. Enjoy!
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
▢ 1 pound dried salt cod desalinated and chopped
▢ 4 medium red potatoes peeled and cut in wedges
▢ ½ cup homemade shrimp stock or store bought
▢ 2 cups water possibly more if needed
